name: MusicPlayer
description:
A now-playing card: cover art, title and artist with a favorite toggle, a seek bar with elapsed and remaining time, and shuffle / previous / play-pause / next / repeat controls - composed from Toggle, Button, Slider and Icon.

  MusicPlayer(title: track.title, artist: track.artist, album: track.album, cover: track.cover_url,
    duration: track.duration, src: track.audio_url)

With `src:` it plays the audio; without, the demo advances the time itself. The controller (`blocks--music-player`) emits `play`, `pause`, `previous`, `next` and `seek` (with { position }), and the favorite / shuffle / repeat toggles emit `ui--toggle:change`. Strings: music_player.locales.yml.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes Blocks (e.g. `MusicPlayer(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes:
The Appica homepage card. Without `src:` the demo advances the time while playing; drag the
seek bar to jump.
examples.code:
phlex do
  MusicPlayer(playing:, favorite:, shuffle:, repeat:, **given(cover_alt:, src:), title:, artist:, album:, cover:, duration:, position: position.to_i, class: "w-95 max-w-full")
end

examples.name: Without cover art
examples.notes: A music tile stands in for a missing cover; long titles truncate.
examples.code:
phlex do
  MusicPlayer(title: "An Extremely Long Track Title That Keeps Going", artist: "Various Artists", duration: 3_725, position: 1_800,
    favorite: true, repeat: true, class: "w-95 max-w-full")
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: Rendered in Arabic whatever the toolbar says.
examples.code:
phlex do
  I18n.with_locale(:ar) do
    div(dir: "rtl") do
      MusicPlayer(title: "قيادة منتصف الليل", artist: "نيون ويفز", cover: "/landing/midnight-drive.svg", duration: 222, position: 84, class: "w-95 max-w-full")
    end
  end
end
